objective: Offer opt-in Public Wall publication as an authenticated member's exact active Cluster/Organization/Sub-organization/Location, showing scope first and a compact byline for members, while verified scope admins publish with official attribution without a public personal byline. Never auto-republish scope-only posts.
productionBaselineEvidence: 2026-11-20: GitHub public/main, Genesis integration source cf99bd23d5e0eea0e56d0921c5b8079f4aeda27c and read-only BUKLOD MAIN schema/function definitions were inspected. Production Android runtime, Expo OTA and device results were not inspected or asserted. No Supabase migration has been applied by this DEV work.
chosenApproach: New RLS-protected attribution table and atomic membership-guarded Public Wall RPC wrap existing public create post validation. Both Public and Scope Wall composers offer explicit destinations. Existing scope-only posting RPC remains unchanged. Public header displays genuine scope name/logo and optionally a small member byline; official scope admins are determined server-side and retain their author ID for audit.
selectionRationale: Switching audience to 'public' on existing scope rows would expose private posts and break exact-scope visibility. Explicit new public posts preserve privacy and keep current feeds and their media/ad lifecycles.
preserveBehaviors: Default Scope Wall posting is members-only and never automatically copied to Public Wall.
Personal Public Wall posts and existing v3 create behavior remain unchanged.
The current public feed only reads canonical public posts and preserves all ranking, media, comment, ad and navigation rules.
A verified scope-admin flag can suppress the public personal byline but the exact author stays auditable server-side.
No new native dependency, configuration or runtime change.
acceptanceChecks: Run Node scope-identity/navigation-scroll regression and Supabase SQL RLS contract tests.
Verify TypeScript check, current Wall header tests, scope posting, comments/reactions and AdMob/navigation regression tests.
On a signed Genesis staging APK verify non-admin location/cluster/suborg public posts, official admin scope posts, wrong-scope rejection and that scope-only rows remain private.
Verify backend migration and feature-compatible runtime against staging using a correct live backend and no production OTA effects.
Only later consider verified RC and a guarded consolidated staging OTA; no production publish from this DEV PR.
alternativeApproaches: Mutate members-only scope posts to audience=public – rejected due permanent confidentiality leak.
Automatically mirror all scope posts in Public Wall – rejected because posting destination must be explicitly chosen.
releaseTarget: Genesis staging consolidated OTA after migration/RC verification; production release separate.
